scope: Read-only AI adjudication of all 30 Gemini mismatching pilot cases, all their checkpoint differences, and all 18 completed initial Haiku predictions. This is not a human review and does not approve or redefine canonical labels.
authority: docs/superpowers/handoffs/correction-aware-memory.md: Atomic input and output; Action semantics and temporal state
Preserved blinded requests.jsonl policy/projection contract for deterministic version IDs, new-head support sets and exact reason codes
Packet observation and prior_versions histories; no reference implementation invoked as correctness oracle
method: Manual per-case reasoning from source annotation, surviving correction lineages, latest effective boundary, inclusive known time, half-open neighboring intervals and permitted provenance. Source schemas/store read only to understand representation. Local standard-library SHA256/span/coverage/integrity checks only; no external requests, credentials, training, tests, or evaluator execution.

overall_findings: No actual gold defect established in the inspected mismatch and completed-Haiku scope. Model disagreement alone supplies no evidence that gold should change.
Repeated notice text across distinct source IDs explains identical SHA256 values. All 50 current source digests and spans validate; distinct IDs do not demonstrate independent evidence or authorship.
known_at is inclusive by the written <= definition; arrival time does not create effective boundaries.

Corrections append a new version at their referenced boundary; the new assertion has new-source support, while old assertions remain in knowledge history. Haiku 0009:o1 violates only the new selected-version ID requirement.
limitations: This adjudicator sees gold, predictions, and written policy; adjudication is unblinded and AI-only. It is a consistency analysis, not independent human validation, empirical proof of gold correctness, or certification of the reviewer/model.

The 50 cases are a stratified development pilot selected from a small synthetic template family. Match rates do not establish generalization or a learned advantage, and 18 successful Haiku outputs are a truncated/error-selected subset, not a completed 50-case Haiku evaluation.

Candidate value/date/authority/correction authorization are trusted loader annotations; extraction, source authenticity and real-world truth are outside scope. Repeated content is not independent corroboration. Historical source_refs omit some original source texts, limiting independent verification of every historical digest.

The handoff states appended correction lineage but does not enumerate every version-ID string or source-set formatting rule. The preserved blinded projection prompt explicitly supplies those representation rules; disagreements solely on those fields concern the supplied contract, not an independently inferred ontology.

All differing checkpoints in the 30 mismatches were inspected. The 20 matching Gemini cases were not subjected to a fresh exhaustive semantic adjudication except overlapping Haiku cases and all-50 input hash/span checks. No conclusion that every canonical label is proven correct follows.

No training/test split access, training, external API calls, tracked-file edits, packet edits, model prediction changes or human verdict changes were performed. Human audit remains one accepted verdict with 49 pending.
